text:
Maya (CS): Heads-up: planning a dedicated pool priming window for Helion next Tue 09:00-11:00 UTC. Goal: validate autoscale behavior, do a phased soak, and confirm quota burn/rollover. Please confirm staffing and any constraints.
Jun (Infra): I can cover infra side. We'll set cluster min=2,max=12 and target CPU util 65% for the autoscaler. Need the expected steady qps and burst plan.
Maya (CS): Initial plan: steady 400 qps for 30m, then 20m ramp to 1500 qps (burst), then 30m soak at 800 qps. Acceptance: p95 < 200ms, error rate <1% 5xx, cache hit >60%. Also validate fallback to smaller model without dropping availability.
Ravi (SRE): Two asks: 1) please run the KV prefill before heavy bursts (see script below). 2) We'll do canary routing 10% -> 50% -> 100% over ~10m steps, telemetry must be green at each step.
Ravi (SRE): ```bash
# prefill kv cache for customer model
python tooling/prefill_kv.py --model helion-v2 --keys 200000 --prefix /helion/
```
Jun (Infra): Perfect. I'll also pin a quantized fallback variant on the nodepool label so router can fallback quickly. I'll add a temporary routing rule: if 95th latency > 350ms then shift 30% to fallback.
Leah (Acct Exec): I'll coordinate with Helion ops for the cutover window and confirm they have an on-call engineer for 09:00-12:00 UTC. Also will schedule a 30-min enablement session after the test to capture feedback and train them on fallback behavior.
Maya (CS): Can someone run the load script and post the job link? We want deterministic seeds so we can reproduce any regression. Also capture traces for a handful of failing requests.
Jun (Infra): Kicking off loadtest now. Command: ```bash
heybench load --target https://api.redwood/helion/v2 --concurrency 400 --duration 00:30:00 --seed 3245 --ramp 00:10:00
```
Jun (Infra): Also scheduling the burst job as a separate job named priming-burst-190123. Will attach CloudWatch/Prometheus dashboards.
deploy-bot: Loadtest queued: job/priming-burst-190123. Estimated run 00:50:00.
Ravi (SRE): Reminder: if p95 crosses 350ms during ramp, abort and scale nodes up manually, do NOT let fallback trigger until we confirm degraded behavior. We'll log all rollbacks.
Maya (CS): Noted. I'll own customer comms and capture CSAT/feedback form post-test. Quick checklist: prefill done? load job link posted? dashboards shared? on-call confirmed?
Jun (Infra): Prefill complete at 1901234580. Load job link: https://ci.redwood/jobs/priming-burst-190123. Dashboards shared with team.
Leah (Acct Exec): Helion ops confirmed on-call. I'll circulate the post-test feedback doc and recording invite.
Maya (CS): Great, thanks. I'll run the acceptance checklist during the test and file a short report in #customer-success after the run. :thumbsup:
Ravi (SRE): I'll standby for abort or manual scale for the first 30m.
Jun (Infra): If anything unexpected, ping me @Jun. Will also leave autoscaler logs open.
Maya (CS): Closing the loop: post-mortem items to capture if something fails — rollback latency patterns, cache prefill coverage, and quota burn anomalies. See you Tuesday. :calendar:
